All work is complete and verified. Final summary of the implementation:

## What I did

**Removed** the broken supplied machinery (64-bit-only `scamptrie_dynamic.*`, `utils/*` incl. the 150 MB `MemInit`, `moo/*`) which printed diagnostics to **stdout** and could not represent 128-bit prefixes.

**Rewrote / added** a clean, self-contained pipeline in `src/` (13 files, 65 KB):

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `scamptrie_base.h` | types, protocol constants/bounds, 128-bit address helpers |
| `fib.{h,cpp}` | live FIB: full 128-bit binary trie, last-write-wins puts, exact LPM, **bounded** LPM (used for BMP fields), enumeration |
| `image_pack.h` | single source of truth for the packed bit offsets of all five record types |
| `image_build.{h,cpp}` | compact exporter: owner grouping (0/16/64), 6-bit-chunk forests, ≤2-prefix collapse to TYPE4/5, TYPE1/2/3 by child count, TYPE3 direct(≤3)/bulk(≥4) split, `stage = 10-level` (children strictly lower, bulk shares one stage), dense even-aligned cell packing → minimum rows, global BMPs, sorted NI dictionary + hole-free NI array |
| `image_validate.{h,cpp}` | whole-image validation before commit: shape/compactness (`rows==ceil(cells/2)`, dense non-overlapping tiling, zero padding), field/reserved bits, absent-child encoding & ordering, strictly-lower stages, owner-max child bound, bulk bitmap/base/stage/contiguity/disjointness, inline fragment normalization/region/length/hop, NI position→ownership, node type vs owned count, single-parent/no-unreachable/no-duplicate, **exact global BMP**, dictionary/NI coverage, front sorted-unique-complete, root presence |
| `image.{hpp,cpp}` | `MemoryImage::load` = validate-then-commit (failure keeps the previous image); detached `lookup` with 64→16→0 front priority |
| `image_io.hpp`, `wire_io.hpp`, `main.cpp` | wire/JSON I/O, buffered reader, single entry point, one JSON response, nothing on stdout |

## Verification (against an independently written Python reference of PROTOCOL.md)

* All 7 public fixtures pass through the *real* `public_check` flow (frozen collect → build → clean env → scored rlimits); `public_check.py` itself can't run in this sandbox because it needs `setsid`, which is denied here.
* ~40 targeted topologies: every length 0…128, ownership boundaries (16/17, 64/65), equal-depth BMP, cross-forest BMP, forest priority, max-depth locals, 64-child TYPE3+bulk, caterpillars, 4096 front16 **and** 4096 front64 keys, hop 0 / 4194302.
* Worst case (2 cases, 11.7 MiB, 131072 puts, 131072 queries, 3 saves, 16 loads, 8192 prefixes): **1.1 s**, all answers correct, snapshots valid, every published bound respected.
* ~2000 differential mutations: C++ loader and Python validator agreed on **every** one; every accepted mutant's lookups match the LPM of its derived FIB (no blind spots).
* Legal-variant repacking (random stage maps, cell orders, direct/bulk splits, NI order, TYPE5 order): always accepted, identical answers.
* Garbage-image fuzz: always rejected, no crashes; end-to-end random op-sequence fuzz: 0 mismatches.
